sourceHeader.components: HS, CM, W (Any Thrown or Ammunition)

system.description:
You unleash a volley of shuriken, kunai or some other thrown or ranged weapon implements and ignite a blaze covering them with fire release chakra, increasing their destructive potential.

Select a creature you can see within range that your enflamed weapons will target and make a ranged Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack, dealing [Weapon Damage] + 3d6 fire damage.

The affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, being Burned on a failed save.

Off-Guard. An off-guard creature that takes damage from this jutsu suffers a 10-foot penalty to their speed and if they don’t move before the end of their next turn, they take 3d6 fire damage at the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of this jutsu by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the Off-Guard effect now applies a 15-foot penalty to a creatures speed.
